title: ai.qory.run.egress
description: One connection the session asked the proxy for, with the decision and the rule that made it. Every connection is one event, allowed or denied.

host.description: The host the session asked for, as a lower-case name or an IP literal.

method.description: CONNECT for a tunnel, HTTP for a plain request through the proxy.

mode.description: The policy mode the decision was made under.

rule.description: The allow entry that matched the host, or empty when none did. In observe mode an empty rule is still allowed; in enforce mode it is denied. Behind a wall, wall:own-address is the wall's own refusal, in either mode: the host is a link-local address, the metadata service say, or the runner's machine with no allow entry naming it.
